items.title: Alien Fashion
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Did you hear that these new aliens from another world arrived in a fashion clothing similar to ours? Get these clothes now and travel to new worlds just like them!

- 12 aliens fashions!
- Something totally out of this world!

items.title: Supernatural Mobs
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Mobs have taken over the world! Get ready for a new trend set among creepers, zombies, spiders, and even slimes! Dress as your favorite mob while enjoying free time with your squad. Good luck with your adventures in this supernatural realm!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Rebel Youth
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Young, wild and free! Meet rebellious spirits that are ready for a luxurious life during summer! Dye your hair, change your fashion style, and become the best version of yourself. Embrace all that you've become and get ready for a new experience during summer!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Luxury Furniture
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Decorate your city with over 65+ furniture options, face the most rich way to be a modern furniture mastermind. Experience a lifestyle full of luxury, splash the cash, and own tons of vehicles!

+ 300x furniture variations!
+ Bunch of vehicles to ride!
+ Rich and luxurious city!
+ Includes tons of modern mansions!

! Only usable in the world provided

items.title: Kraken Colosseum
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: A mega monster hunted hundred of years ago now is one of the main attractions of the battle island! Fight with mobs in the epic kraken colosseum.

items.title: Default Skyblock
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: Plenty of themes to choose, but the best choice is always the most simple one. Adventure in the default skyblock and enjoy a retro experience. As always, create your path and defeat the ender dragon, good luck!

items.title: Crater Village
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description: In a mysterious crater protected by giant waterfalls, the deepest village in the world appears. Explore what this village brought to your world!

items.title: Colorful Gamers
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Start your gamer career today with the new Colorful Gamers skin pack! Enjoy and have fun exploring the world of gaming with your friends!

+ 8 teens gamer themed skins included
+ Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Noel Design.

items.title: Pets HD Skin Pack
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
The cutest pets in town just arrived and they're dressed to impress! Choose your favorite furry animal among these 17 HD skins!

- Includes dogs, cats and exotic pets!
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Blue Pixel Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Our pixels are big, bold, and blue! Check out this collection of trendy blue themed fashion for teens. Offering a classic game feel with your favorite color for an everyday survival or roleplay experience.

+ 14 skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Neon Armor
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay wearing neon glowing armor!

+ 10 roleplay-ready skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Modern Mob Onesies
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Wear a mob onesie! Roleplay as a mob!

+ 14 mob onesie skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Stylish Suits
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Are you ready to rock a stylish suit? Suit up and get ready to rock!

+ 10 suited skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Rainbow Connection
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
We are all connected in the rainbow of life, so why not show it off by breaking through the boundaries that confine us. Be the you that's colorful! Be the you that's proud! Be the you that's an ally! Be the you that breaks through the noise! With this playful skin pack, you can show off the best version of you. 

- 10 skins
- 2 included skins are free

items.title: Nerdy Heroes
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Who imagined that one day the world will be rescued by nerdy heroes? Join your squad and save the world!

- 21 heroic skins
+ 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Modern Underwater Base
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Discover a luxurious base hidden under the ocean depths... Find its entrance and take the big elevator to get there!

- An epic underwater base!
- Tons of fun alone or with your friends!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Shipwreck Island
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
The ship got lost on the ocean and a big storm pushed the ship into the island, the crew decided to stay, and with the ship's remains, they created the island their home. Explore this legendary island, full of mysteries and great treasures. Perfect for roleplaying with your friends.

- Chests full of treasures!
- Hidden dungeons!
- By Pixelusion & Pixel Smile Studios

items.title: Enchanted Gem Survival
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
In this enchanted survival spawn you will meet unusual, magical creatures, and gain superhero-like abilities by eating the enchanted gems along the way. With beautiful caves and custom mine shafts filled with fun and danger, there is a surprise around every corner. 

- Beautiful cave systems
- Trade with friendly villagepillars
- Created by G2Crafted, a father and son team

items.title: Break Free
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Not all prisoners stay locked behind bars, some break free. Maybe in their mind the orange jumpsuit and striped outfit just isn’t their style.

items.title: Karate
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Some experts take years to master their craft while others can take decades. Your skills in martial arts are a lifetime in the making. When you are challenged to fight you do not fear for yourself but you fear for your opponent.

items.title: Cave Creatures
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Some of the most mysterious and dangerous creatures never see the light of day. They choose to remain hidden beneath the ground in caves aimlessly wandering the depths. Their choice to live in the shadows is not in fear of us but rather a necessity of survival as they feed off the darkness. All who have wandered into their caves have yet to return.

items.title: Summer Demons
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Summer and warmth is here, along with teen demon skins & trendy fashion. Enjoy the summer vibes with your buddies now! What are you waiting for?!

- 8 AWESOME skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns

items.title: Basketball Pros
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you ready to be a basketball star? Just pick your favorite outfit and hit the court! It's time to show who the best player is!

+ 12 skins (2 free)
+ Basketball themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: K-POP STARS
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you ready to be a KPOP star? These skins are all for you and extremely cool! Choose the skin you want and start your career!

+ 12 skins (2 free)
+ KPOP themed
+ Perfect for teens
+ Perfect for roleplay
